page: UpCloud GPU-32xCPU-384GB-2xL4 is a GPU-accelerated virtual server built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 32 vCPUs configured with shared CPU allocation. The system is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 12.0 GB per vCPU.

Acceleration is driven by two NVIDIA L4 GPUs from the Ada Lovelace architecture family, providing a combined total of 48 GB of VRAM. This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning external block storage must be attached for persistent data. It includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

The shared CPU allocation presents a potential performance tradeoff for workloads requiring sustained, non-burstable CPU processing. However, the high memory capacity combined with dual NVIDIA L4 GPUs makes this configuration structurally aligned with memory-intensive GPU workloads. Appropriate applications include machine learning inference, data science pipelines, and graphics rendering tasks that leverage GPU acceleration without requiring dedicated CPU cores.
